															51 tree item Done Use the MCP server engineering skills - The file is valid JSON. The problem is that it is **setup metadata**, not invocation metadata. `recoverInterruptedInvocations()` recursively scanned every `metadata.json`, including: ```text issues/.../setup-attempts/.../metadata.json ``` It then tried to validate that file as an invocation. Setup metadata lacks fields such as `invocationId`, `scope`, `phase`, and `promptCapture`, so parsing failed with the misleading `Malformed invocation metadata` error. The bug was the overly broad file discovery, not corruption in the metadata. 34m
